[[File:Medical_diagnostic_computer_SW_TAFA.jpg|250px|thumb|[[2-1B/Legends|2-1B's]] handheld medical diagnostic computer]]
A '''medical diagnostic computer''', also known simply as a '''diagnostic computer''', was a type of [[Computer/Legends|computer]] used for diagnosing medical conditions. Medical diagnostic computers were installed aboard [[Medical droid/Legends|medical droids]] such as the [[2-1B surgical droid/Legends|2-1B surgical droid]],<ref name="Droids">''[[The New Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref> though they also came in handheld versions. [[Tamo Lan]] carried one,<ref name="CRO">{{JournalCite|10|Cracken's Rebel Operatives (article)}}</ref> and they were also available in a miniaturized version.<ref name="MB">[[Star Wars Miniatures Battles (first edition)|''Star Wars Miniatures Battles'', First Edition]]</ref>
